name: gamestock
description: Desktop game collection manager for ROM libraries and physical inventory.

scripts.dev:windows: concurrently -k --success first -n VITE,TSC,ELECTRON "vite --host 127.0.0.1" "tsc -p tsconfig.main.json -w" "wait-on tcp:5173 file:dist/main/index.js file:dist/preload/index.js && set ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=&& electron ."
scripts.dist:windows: npm run build:renderer && npm run build:main && electron-builder --win && npm run package:s3-release
scripts.test:rom-folder-import: npm run build:main && set ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=&& electron scripts/test-rom-folder-import.cjs
scripts.test:launchbox:e2e: npm run build:renderer && npm run build:main && set ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=&& electron scripts/e2e-launchbox.cjs
scripts.test:launchbox:e2e:packaged: npm run dist:windows && set ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=&& set GAMESTOCK_E2E_PACKAGED=1&& electron scripts/e2e-launchbox.cjs
